title: Thousands march in Barcelona for public education and housing
seoTitle: Barcelona march for education and housing

tea.why: Protesters seek better funding for public education, improved working conditions for teachers, and affordable housing.
tea.want: They demand 6% of GDP for education, lower student-teacher ratios, salary increases, and more resources for inclusive education.
tea.changed: Nov 21: Thousands marched in Barcelona to protest ahead of a planned education strike on November 26.

summary: Thousands of people marched through central Barcelona on November 21, 2026, to advocate for public education and housing rights. Organised by various unions including Ustec, CGT, and the Intersindical, with support from the Sindicat de Llogateres, the demonstration moved from Plaça Urquinaona to Plaça Sant Jaume. Participants demanded that 6% of the GDP be allocated to public education, alongside calls for reduced student-teacher ratios and improved salary conditions. The march also served as a precursor to a scheduled education strike on November 26. While the event was described as having a family-friendly atmosphere, union representatives expressed dissatisfaction with the current negotiations with the Generalitat. Authorities have not provided a formal response to the specific demands raised during the march, though the protest highlighted ongoing tensions between the government and education sector unions.
response: No official response reported in the sources.

crowd.text: 3,000 according to the Guardia Urbana, 5,000 according to the organisers

updates.text: Thousands marched in Barcelona to demand improvements in public education and housing.
